summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Lloyds Bank plc reporting its unaudited consolidated interim results for the three months ended 31 March 2026. It is a routine quarterly earnings release, not a special situation event. The document includes forward-looking statements and is incorporated by reference into a registration statement. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or corporate action is described. The filing serves purely as an update on financial performance with no deal terms or structural changes.
